import itertools

def dihedral(g, name):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    if name=='id': return [r[:] for r in g]
    if name=='h': return [r[::-1] for r in g]
    if name=='v': return [r for r in zip(*g)][::-1]
    if name=='180': return [row[::-1] for row in g[::-1]]
    if name=='d': return [r for r in zip(*g)][::-1][::-1]
    if name=='d2': return [r[::-1] for r in g][::-1]
    if name=='d3': return [r for r in zip(*g[::-1])]
    raise ValueError(name)

def normalize(g):
    # remove all-zero rows/cols from edges? keep shape; just crop to bounding box of nonzero
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v!=0]
    ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    o=[[g[i+min(ys)][j-min(xs)] for j in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for i in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]
    return o

for pn in ['Demo pair 5','Demo pair 1']:
    gi,go=G[pn+' input'],G[pn+' output']
    print('===',pn,'out',(len(go),len(go[0])),'in',(len(gi),len(gi[0])))

    for name,o in [(n,dihedral(gi,n)) for n in ['id','h','v','180','d','d2','d3']]:
        no=normalize(o)
        if len(no)==len(go) and len(no[0])==len(go[0]):
            sub=(no==go)
            hits.append((name,sub, no==go))
    print(hits)

def analyze(pn):
    gi,go=G[pn+' input'],G[pn+' output']
    cs,bg=comps2(gi)
    # marker: color in >=2 comps
    cnt={}
    for c in cs: cnt.update({gi[y][x]:1 for y,x in c})
    marker=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if n>=2]
    print(pn,'marker',marker)
    occ={(y,x):go[y][x] for y in range(len(go)) for x in range(len(go[0])) if go[y][x]!=bg}
    used=set()
    for c in sorted(cs,key=lambda c:min(y for y,x in c)):
        ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
        cr,cc=min(ys),min(xs)
        h=max(ys)-cr+1; w=max(xs)-cc+1
        cells=[(y-cr,x-cc,gi[y][x]) for y,x in c]
        # expected final cells: same rel positions, recolored (marker->other color of comp)
        other=[v for _,_,v in cells if v!=marker[0]][0] if len({v for _,_,v in cells})==2 else None
        pred=[(r,cl,v if v!=marker[0] else other) for r,cl,v in cells]
        # find placement: match pred subset of occ allowing overlap resolution; try all (dr,dc) with no conflicts
        okpl=[]
        for dr in range(-len(gi),len(gi)):
            for dc in range(-len(gi[0]),len(gi[0])):
                conf=False
                for r,cl,v in pred:
                    ny,nx=r+dr,cl+dc
                    if not(0<=ny<len(go)) or not(0<=nx<len(go[0])): continue
                    ov = occ.get((ny,nx))
                    if ov is None or ov!=v: conf=True;break
                if not conf: okpl.append((dr,dc))
        print(' comp bbox',(cr,cc,h,w),'cells',len(cells),'marker?',marker,'placements:',okpl[:6],'...' if len(okpl)>6 else '')
analyze('Demo pair 1'); analyze('Demo pair 2'); analyze('Demo pair 5')

def find_shape(go,bg):
    # cells of output; assume all non-bg cells in one comp; return (dims, relative map)
    pts=[(y,x) for y in range(len(go)) for x in range(len(go[0])) if go[y][x]!=bg]
    ys=[p[0] for p in pts]; xs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    mr=max(y-min(ys) for y,_ in pts); mc=max(x-min(xs) for _,x in pts)
    m=[[bg]*(mc+1) for _ in range(mr+1)]
    for y,x in pts: m[y-min(ys)][x-min(xs)]=go[y][x]
    return (mr,mc),m

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
from collections import Counter
def comps4(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                q=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; c=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); c.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]!=bg and not seen[ny][nx]:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                res.append(c)
    return res,bg

def slide_rule(pn, diag=True):
    gi=G[pn+' input']; go=G[pn+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    cs,bg_=comps4(gi)
    # anchor: comp containing leftmost non-bg cell (col0 touch preferred else nearest col0)
    def dist(c): return min(x for y,x in c)
    cs.sort(key=dist)
    anchor=cs[0]; rest=cs[1:]
    mk=None
    # find stray marker cells and their color: color of cells with no same-color orth neighbor
    nbs=((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
    scell=[(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w)
          if gi[y][x]!=bg and not any(0<=y+dy<h and 0<=x+dx<w and gi[y+dy][x+dx]==gi[y][x]
              for dy,dx in nbs)]
    mk=set(gi[y][x] for y,x in scell)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def paint(cells,color):
        for y,x in cells:
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=color
    anchor_c=gi[anchor[0][0]][anchor[0][1]]
    paint(anchor,anchor_c)
    for c in rest:
        # determine slide direction: from comp toward anchor (delta sign)
        ay=min(y for y,x in anchor); ax=min(x for y,x in anchor)
        sy=(ay>max(y for y,x in c))*(1) or ((ay<min(y for y,x in c))*(-1) or 0)
        sx=(ax>min(x for y,x in c))*(1) or ((ax<max(x for y,x in c))*(-1) or 0)
        dy_,dx_=sy,sx
        ch=True
        while ch:
            ch=False
            nc=[[gi[y][x] for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
            for y,x in c: nc[y][x+dy_]=gi[y][x]
            # check collision/overlap with painted canvas: any cell painted with non-bg colliding -> stop
            ok=True
            for y,x in c:
                yy,xx=y,x+dy_
                if not(0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w) or out[yy][xx]!=bg: ok=False;break
            if not ok: break
            for y,x in c:
                yy,xx=y,x+dy_; out[yy][xx]=gi[y][x]
            ch=True
        # recolor: marker-colored cells become comp's majority color
        colcnt=Counter(gi[y][x] for y,x in c)
        main=max(colcnt,key=colcnt.get)
        for y,x in c:
            if gi[y][x] in mk: out[y][x]=main
    return out==go,out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps_of(g,bg=None):
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get) if bg is None else bg
    pts={(y,x) for y in range(len(g)) for x in range(len(g[0])) if g[y][x]!=bg}
    res=[]
    while pts:
        seed=next(iter(pts)); q=[seed]; comp={seed}; pts.discard(seed)
        while q:
            y,x=q.pop()
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if n in pts: pts.discard(n); q.append(n); comp.add(n)
        res.append(sorted(comp))
    return res,bg
def solve(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cs,bg=comps_of(gi)
    # order: sort by min col then row
    order=sorted(range(len(cs)),key=lambda i:(min(x for y,x in cs[i]),min(y for y,x in cs[i])))
    occ=set(); placed=[]
    for idx in order:
        c=cs[idx]; colr=gi[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
        cells=list(c)
        while True:
            nxt=[(y-1,x-1) for y,x in cells]
            if any(not(0<=y<h and 0<=x<w) for y,x in nxt) or any(p in occ for p in nxt): break
            cells=nxt
        for y,x in cells: occ.add((y,x)); placed.append((y,x,colr))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for y,x,v in placed: out[y][x]=v
    maxc=max(max(x for y,x,_ in placed),default=-1); out=[[bg]*(maxc+1) for _ in out]
    for y,x,v in placed: out[y][x]=v
    return out
ok=True
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    o=solve(gi)
    m=o==go
    ok&=m
    print(i,m, '' if m else [(r,c,o[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(len(go)) for c in range(len(go[0])) if o[r][c]!=go[r][c]][:6])
print('ALL',ok)

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def find_comps(g,bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); pts={(y,x) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if g[y][x]!=bg}
    res=[]
    while pts:
        seed=next(iter(pts)); q=[seed]; comp={seed}; pts.discard(seed)
        while q:
            y,x=q.pop()
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if n in pts: pts.discard(n); q.append(n); comp.add(n)
        res.append(sorted(comp))
    return res
def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    cs=find_comps(gi,bg)
    # anchor: component touching column 0; stays fixed
    anchor=None
    for c in cs:
        if any(x==0 for y,x in c): anchor=c; break
    occ=set(anchor) if anchor else set()
    others=sorted([c for c in cs if c!=anchor],key=lambda c:(min(x for y,x in c),min(y for y,x in c)))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for y,x in anchor: out[y][x]=gi[y][x]
    for c in others:
        cells=list(c)
        while True:
            nxt=[(y-1,x-1) for y,x in cells]
            if any(y<0 or x<0 for y,x in nxt) or any(p in occ for p in nxt): break
            cells=nxt
        occ.update(cells)
        colr=gi[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=colr
    # crop to used columns
    used_cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(out[y][j]!=bg for y in range(h))]
    outcrop=[[row[i] for i in used_cols] for row in out]
    return outcrop
ok=True
for i in range(1,9):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%i]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%i]
    o=f(gi)
    m=o==go; ok&=m
    print(i,m,'shape',len(o),'x',len(o[0]),'exp',len(go),'x',len(go[0]))
print('ALL',ok)
